name: mcp.savee.com
description:
Savee is a curated visual-inspiration platform for designers. Over 1.5 million members save images and videos from across the web into boards.

This connector lets Claude read your Savee account and search Savee's public library. Ask what you've been saving lately and have it grouped by theme, have Claude describe the visual direction a board is converging on, pull source links for everything with a particular dominant colour, or search the wider library for references you haven't saved yet and compare them against your own work.

Every save comes back with its image or video URL, the original source URL, dimensions and dominant colours, so Claude can reason about what's actually in your collection rather than just its titles.

Read-only by design: nothing here can save, edit, move or delete anything in your account. You approve each permission when you connect and can revoke access at any time from your Savee settings. Requires an active Savee subscription.

_published_faq.name: How do I add mcp.savee.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add mcp.savee.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.savee.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the mcp.savee.com MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: mcp.savee.com provides these MCP tools: get_current_user, list_board_saves, list_boards, list_feed, list_saves, and search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to mcp.savee.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to mcp.savee.com in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
mcp.savee.com requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
mcp.savee.com is developed by Savee. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
